name: Art and Love
source:
A visual novel about everyday life at art college with plenty of adult content! Meet the characters and discover their unique personalities and hobbies! 

[Edited from [url=https://ursk.itch.io/art-and-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
這是一部描繪藝術學院日常生活的視覺小說，含有大量成人內容！來認識這些角色，瞭解他們各自獨特的個性和愛好吧！
